ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this content block. This does not display to site visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionAriaLabel.helper: Admin/accessibility field. Used only when no contact heading is provided, so the section still has an accessible label.

SocialHeadingLead.helper: Bold first part of the social heading.

SocialHeadingText.helper: Regular text shown after the bold social heading lead.

SocialLinks.helper: Add social links in display order. Network controls the hover/focus color class.

Network.helper: Controls the network-specific hover and focus color.

Icon.helper: Font Awesome class list. Only letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, and spaces are rendered.

Url.helper: Optional link. Allowed protocols: http, https, mailto, tel, anchors, and relative URLs. If blank, the item renders as non-clickable text.

ContactHeadingLead.helper: Regular first part of the contact heading.

ContactHeadingEmphasis.helper: Bold second part of the contact heading.

ContactIntro.helper: Introductory contact copy. HTML is encoded for safety; line breaks are preserved.
ContactIntro.placeholder: Reach our team directly through the contact details below.

ContactItems.helper: Add contact rows in display order.

Icon.helper: Font Awesome class list. Only letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, and spaces are rendered.

Label.helper: Bold label shown before the value.

Value.helper: Contact value. Line breaks are rendered safely as line breaks.
Value.placeholder:
1200 Aerospace Way, Suite 400
Arlington, VA 22202, USA

HoursHeadingLead.helper: Regular first part of the hours heading.

HoursHeadingEmphasis.helper: Bold second part of the hours heading.

HourItems.helper: Add normal hours rows in display order.

Icon.helper: Font Awesome class list. Only letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, and spaces are rendered.

Label.helper: Bold label shown before the value.

Value.helper: Hours value. Line breaks are rendered safely as line breaks.
